title: Customer-risk sensitivity

questions.text: Is the proposed commercial action appropriate given current customer risk?

inputs: open support, security or compliance issues

criteria.text: an unresolved severe issue suppresses the commercial push
criteria.guide: Severe open support or compliance issues come before commercial asks.
When the relationship deteriorates, the action lowers pressure or changes channel.

criteria.text: recovery comes before expansion where needed
criteria.guide: A customer-success problem may require a recovery step before any expansion.

principles: unresolved severe support issue should suppress aggressive upsell
customer success problem may require recovery before expansion

diagnostics.name: customer_risk_conflicts_with_upsell
diagnostics.when: the action sells into open customer risk
